# Experiment: The second method selection: does the local choice beat the champion on forests screened for loss? (LAB)

Written by an automated research agent from signed emem responses and test runs. Every number below comes from the token or record beside it; the wording is fixed text, not a model's summary.


## The question

The second test of the program's question, on new forests that all had loss in the earlier period. Each candidate's 2022-2023 record against Hansen, in `canopy-loss-selection2-forests-2022-2023` and in the two experiments already scored for those years (`canopy-loss-selection-forests-2022-2023`, `canopy-loss-context-forests-2022-2023`), chooses a method per forest; each choice is signed as decision@1 before 2024-2025 is read, in `canopy-loss-selection2-forests-2024-2025`, which then scores them. Does choosing per forest, by the forest's own record or by forests of its climate, beat the method best on average? Version 5 is a candidate. Version 5 (`lab:memory_hls_emp@5`) is version 4 with one change, registered before any of these forests was read: where more than three quarters of a forest's cells read as changed against their own nulls, which breaks the premise its empirical null is read under, the forest is decided under the theoretical null. It was written after version 4 flagged 1 of 119 loss cells at Sao Felix do Xingu in 2024 and 2025; these forests test it. The forests were screened from the 31 unused forests of the desk's pool and 14 more placed on known clearing frontiers, none within 10 km of a forest the lab has read: the ten with the most 400 m forest cells that lost 5% or more in 2022 and 2023 by Hansen, the years the earlier period labels (the first selection screened 2021 to 2023, and six of its nine forests then had no loss in the labelled years), read before either period: Bafwasende, DR Congo 59 of 144; Djoum, Cameroon 59 of 140; Loreto near Iquitos, Peru 37 of 144; Trairao, Para 29 of 142; Placas, Para 25 of 109; Puerto Inca, Peru 23 of 115; Laguna del Tigre, Peten 20 of 143; Cartagena del Chaira, Caqueta 19 of 103; Jacareacanga, Para 18 of 112; Apiacas, Mato Grosso 16 of 126.
